fact: Burundi's Council of Ministers adopted the draft law on access to public information on 10 June 2026, with corrections, and it is to go to both chambers of parliament before promulgation; the ministry says there is currently a legal vacuum on access to public information.

fact: Burundi's Senate unanimously adopted a bill establishing a legal right of access to public information in plenary on Tuesday 29 September 2026, according to the Senate's X account; the article says it is not stated whether the bill returns to the National Assembly or goes to the president for promulgation.
system: Bill on access to public information

fact: Le Renouveau reports that a bill on access to information was on the programme of the National Assembly's ordinary session opened on 3 August 2026.
